adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a security issue in refreshOAuthTokens.ts. Looking at the diff, when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, the code makes a POST request with only calcomUserId and appSlug in the body, with no authentication headers or secrets. The webhook endpoint (app-credential.ts) validates CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET in headers, but the refreshOAuthTokens.ts outbound request doesn't include any such authentication. This means the external credential sync endpoint receives unauthenticated requests that could be spoofed if the endpoint is publicly accessible. This is a legitimate security concern - the outbound sync request lacks authentication credentials.
